name: Bhoot
description: A bhoot is the restless ghost of a deceased person in South Asian (Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, Bengali, Pakistani, Bangladeshi) folklore — typically someone who died violently, prematurely, or without proper funeral rites and so cannot pass to the afterlife.

aliases.name: भूत (bhūta)
aliases.meaning: 'that which has been'; can mean spirit, element, or ghost

aliases.name: churel / chudail
aliases.meaning: Female bhoot of a woman who died in childbirth, with reversed feet

aliases.name: pret
aliases.meaning: Hungry ghost; specific class of bhoot

origin: Pan-South Asian: India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka, and the South Asian diaspora (Caribbean, East Africa, UK, North America). Term and beliefs cross Hindu, Muslim, Sikh, and Christian South Asian communities.
